beats.label: Hallo. This is Liam, in for Bear. Claude just opened a portal for plugins. So the question isn't onl
Three terms. MCP, the Model Context Protocol: an open standard that plugs Claude into outside tools
Start with the plugin itself. Picture it as a sealed box. What goes inside?
A plugin is a package. Inside go MCP connectors, which plug Claude into outside tools and data, and
There are two ways to submit one. Way one is a single MCP connector. You point it at your own remote
Way two is a plugin bundle. You put your MCP servers and your skills together in a GitHub repository
You submit right inside Claude, from the directory's manage page, if you're a developer on a paid pl
Then you can track it. The portal shows where your plugin is in review, what the safety scan found,
